proposition: The Munshaʾāt-i Turka testifies to warm relations with Niʿmat Allāh Valī, Qāsim-i Anvār, Aḥmad Samarqandī, ʿAlā al-Dīn Chishtī (administrator of Shāhrukh's Herat madrasa-khanaqah) and Ḥasan ʿAṭṭār, among others, and this corroborates his apologies' account of dealings with shaykhs.
